about: local contests of 2022 in Idaho, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2022 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP, version 5.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2022-id-local-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

id_sos.name: Idaho Secretary of State, 2022 General Election official results: statewide offices
id_sos.licence: no licence printed; the Idaho Secretary of State's public election returns
id_sos.via: pipeline/intake/id_sos.py; linked as 'Statewide Results' from https://sos.idaho.gov/elections-division/idaho-election-results/ (served from https://voteidaho.gov/election-results/); a vendor's host the state names, marked "the results page's heading 'OFFICIAL ELECTION RESULTS', all 44 counties fully reporting" (the orchestrator's ruling of 12:40)
id_sos.note: the votes of each contest whose result.votes_source is 'id_sos' (MEDSL's, the COUNTY TOTAL rule applied, in result.medsl_votes); checked: each candidate's total equals the canvass's TOTAL row to the vote (the canvass, https://archive.sos.idaho.gov/elections/data/results/2022/2022_General_Canvass.zip, sha256 27aac1e2c391b2d5)
